translations.text: And he said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
Set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, strengthen your arm, and prophesy against it.
And I said, “God, Lord of lords, I have never been defiled. From my youth until today, I have not eaten a diseased animal or one torn apart by wild animals, and no unclean meat has entered my mouth.”
But you, son of man, take a sword as sharp as a barber’s razor, and pass it over your head and your beard. Take weighing scales and divide the hair into three portions.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
I will cast the corpses of the house of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
Those who are far away will die of plague, and those who are near will fall by the sword. Those who remain and escape will die of famine, and I will fully carry out my wrath against them.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Now, very soon, I will pour out my fury on you and pour out my wrath on you. I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your uncleanness upon you.
And there was the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.
When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved with them. When the cherubim lifted their wings to rise from the earth, the wheels did not turn away from them.
Therefore, this is what the Lord of lords says: “Your slain whom you have cast within it are the meat, and it is the cooking pot. But I will bring you out of it.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
And I told the exiles all the words of the Lord that he had shown me.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, what is this proverb that people use about you in the land of Israel, saying, “The days drag on, and every vision comes to nothing”?

Therefore, tell them, “This is what the Lord of lords says: I will put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer use it in Israel.” Instead, tell them, “The days are approaching, and every vision will come true.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy for themselves. Say to those who prophesy out of their own hearts, “Hear the word of the Lord of lords.”
You have not gone up into the breach, nor have you built a wall around the house of Israel so that it could stand in battle on the day of the Lord.
You have seen an empty vision and spoken a lying divination. You say, “The Lord has spoken,” but I have not spoken.
Therefore, this is what the Lord of lords says: “I will make a storm wind blow in my fury. There will be a sweeping rain in my wrath, and hailstones will bring destruction in my fury.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their hearts and set the stumbling block of their wrongdoing before their faces. I will exact retribution from them.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:

You adorned yourself with gold and pearls, and dressed in fine linen, blue cloth, and embroidered fabric. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You became exceedingly beautiful and attained royal status.
The bread I gave you—fine flour, honey, and oil for food—you set before them as a pleasing fragrance, says the Lord of lords.
As I live, says the Lord of lords, your sister Sodom and her daughters have not done what you and your daughters have done.
So that you may bear disgrace and be ashamed of everything you have done to provoke me to anger.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:

Say, “This is what the Lord of lords says: It will not thrive. Instead, its roots will be cut off, and its fruit will decay and wither. All the leaves of its growth will wither. It will not take a mighty arm or a great multitude to uproot it by its roots.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
He walked among the lions and became a lion. He learned to tear prey apart and ate human beings.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:

The house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my commandments, and they rejected my judgments, by which a person will live if he carries them out. They profaned my Sabbaths, and I said that I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness and destroy them.
As I live, says the Lord of lords, I will rule over you with a mighty hand, an outstretched arm, and wrath poured out.
Just as I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord of lords.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Make a road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, against Judah, and against fortified Jerusalem.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Those far from you and those near you will mock you and say, “She whose names are defiled and whose injustices are many!”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Just as silver, copper, iron, tin, and lead are gathered inside a furnace, and fire is blown upon them to melt them, so I will gather you in my anger and melt you in my wrath.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Her sister Oholibah saw this, but her lust became more corrupt than her sister’s, and her prostitution greater than her sister’s prostitution.
Therefore, this is what the Lord of lords says: Look, I am handing you over to those you hated, to the Assyrians, from whom you recoiled.
Therefore, this is what the Lord of lords says: Because you forgot me and gave yourself over to following your idols, you too must bear your guilt and your prostitution.
They committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols, and they burn in the fire their children whom they bore to me.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, turn your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
This is what the Lord of lords says: Because Edom took vengeance on the house of Judah, committed a grave offense, and acted against them in jealousy,
They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. They will scrape her soil away from her, and I will make her like a smooth rock.
I will make you a smooth rock, a place for spreading fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, because I have spoken, says the Lord of lords.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the death of those slain in the heart of the seas.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
When they grasped you with their hands, you pierced their hands. When they leaned on you, you broke and made their loins tremble.
The land of Egypt will become a ruin and a wasteland, and they will know that I am the Lord, because you said, “The river is mine, and I made it.”
I will bring back the captives of Egypt and settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were sold, and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
I made it beautiful with its many branches, and all the trees of Eden, the garden of God, envied it.
I will darken over you all the lights that shine in the heavens, and I will bring darkness upon your land, says the Lord of lords.
I will make many nations astonished at you, and their kings will be afraid when I flash my sword before them. They will fear and tremble, each for his own life, on the day of your downfall.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
When he sees the sword coming against them, he must blow the horn and warn the people.
If he returns the pledge he took, repays what he stole, follows the commandments of life, and does no wrong, he will surely live and will not die.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, those living in these ruins in the land of Israel say, “Abraham was only one man, yet he inherited the land. We are many; will we not inherit it?”

As for you, son of man, your people talk about you beside the walls and at the doors of the houses. They speak to one another, each man to his brother, saying, “Come, listen to what word has come from the Lord.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
My sheep were scattered because they had no shepherd, and they became food for all the wild animals.

I will pasture them in a good grazing place, and their dwelling will be on the high mountains of Israel. There they will lie down in a good dwelling place and graze in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
I, the Lord, will be their God, and my servant David will be ruler among them.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it.
You opened your mouths wide against me and multiplied your words against me, and I heard.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:

He said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath: This is what the Lord of lords says: Come, breath, from the four winds, and breathe into these slain people so that they may live.”
Therefore prophesy and say to them, “This is what the Lord of lords says: Look, I am opening your graves and bringing you up from your graves, and I am bringing you to the land of Israel.”
You will know that I am the Lord when I open your graves and bring you up from your graves.
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
You will say, “I will go up against a prosperous land and attack those who live peacefully, who have no walls, bars, or gates.”
I will subdue you, gather you, bring you up from the far reaches of the north, and bring you to the mountains of Israel.
I will send fire upon Magog and upon the inhabitants of the islands who live peacefully, and they will know that I am the Lord.
The inhabitants of the towns of Israel will go out and set fire to the weapons, shields, javelins, bows, arrows, hand clubs, and spears. They will burn them as fuel for seven years.
After seven months, men will continually travel through the land and bury those who remain in the land, so that it may be cleansed.
Its interior, porches, and thresholds had these same measurements, and it and its porches had windows all around. Its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five.
Between the chambers surrounding the house, the width was twenty cubits.
The outer wall opposite the chambers was fifty cubits long.
He finished measuring the inner house and brought me out by way of the gate facing east, and he measured it all around.
He measured the western side: five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
You have not kept charge of my sanctuary, but you have appointed your own guards to keep charge of my sanctuary.
The priests must not drink wine when they enter the inner courtyard.
After he becomes defiled, he must count seven days for himself, and then he will be purified.
The priests must not eat any bird or animal that has been strangled or torn apart.
It will be twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide, and it will be an inheritance for the Levites who serve in the house: twenty houses.

The priest must take some of the blood of the purification offering and sprinkle it on the thresholds of the house, on the four corners of the altar, and on the threshold of the gate of the inner courtyard.

When the people of the land come before the Lord at festival time, whoever enters through the north gate to worship must leave through the south gate, and whoever enters through the south gate must leave through the north gate. No one must return through the gate by which they entered, but must leave through the opposite one.
At the time of the festival, there shall be a seah of fine flour for a bull and a seah for a ram; for a lamb, each person shall give according to what he can afford, and a hin of oil for each seah.
Its outlets and inlets will not become fresh, but will remain salt.
You shall divide this land among the tribes of Israel.

These are the names of the tribes: from the northern end, along the road of Hethlon, at the entrance to Hamath and Hazar-enan, and the boundary of Damascus to the north beside Hamath—this is the side east of the sea belonging to Dan.
They shall not sell any of it or exchange it, nor shall they transfer the first portion of the land, because it is holy to the Lord.
Its perimeter shall be eighteen thousand, and the name of the city from that time on shall be “The Lord Is There.”
